authority_boundary.protected_solver_strip: The existing C3 solver corridor within plus or minus 39 meters of centerline is copied exactly and remains gameplay authority.
authority_boundary.terrain: Visual Landscape height is deterministic procedural canyon infill outside the protected strip; official USGS and NPS references constrain landform classes only and do not make it surveyed Hance terrain, lithology, rapid-rock, or geospatial authority.
authority_boundary.terrain_collision: Landscape collision follows the visual infill only outside the protected strip and does not alter protected water, bathymetry, solver, buoyancy, or raft-force authority.
authority_boundary.vegetation: Four project-owned opaque procedural dryland meshes are non-colliding, remain outside the protected strip, and carry explicit source-constrained procedural-fallback plus no-ecology, no-geography, and no-hydraulic-authority tags.
authority_boundary.water_and_gameplay: The retained water presentation, raw WaterSamples, finite-volume solver state, runtime coordinate map, collision, buoyancy, and raft-force paths are unchanged by this milestone.

terrain_contract.interpretation: Seeded multiscale massing, incised drainage, irregular basement-rock buttresses, talus, and a bounded rapid-adjacent debris-fan analog reduce the remaining sine-like terrace signature while preserving the protected solver corridor exactly.

official_reference_contract.interpretation_boundary: References constrain landform and ecology classes only; no downloaded geometry, surveyed Hance registration, lithologic boundary, rapid-rock coordinate, exact species inventory, or hydraulic input is claimed.

capture_comparison.technical_verdict: retain: the long regular outer-bank grooves are reduced, asymmetrical eroded massing is stronger, a bounded debris-fan landform class is present, and two ground-cover plus two shrub morphologies provide denser bank breakup without entering the protected solver corridor
capture_comparison.photoreal_verdict: fail: terrain remains generic procedural infill, opaque generated shrubs remain visibly stylized, exact species and geology are unreviewed, and the retained water, rocks, atmosphere, and VFX remain below production fidelity

remaining_photoreal_defects: The outer canyon is deterministic procedural infill rather than surveyed and geospatially registered Hance terrain, and it does not reproduce exact strata, alcoves, talus fields, erosion cuts, debris-fan boundaries, or bank breaklines.

Generated opaque plants remain stylized analogs rather than reviewed tamarisk, willow, cactus, grass, or other exact river-corridor species; they lack ecology authority, wind response, seasonal variation, and close-range production geometry.
Boulders remain sparse, repeated, and procedural rather than surveyed, geology-reviewed, source-varied Hance rock assets.

Horizontal water bands remain visible, foam remains sparse lace rather than hydraulic structure, and the water lacks credible crests, holes, rollers, entrained aeration, spray, mist, rock-water contact, and raft occlusion.
Canyon horizon, lighting, atmosphere, and distant geographic context remain generic rather than a verified Hance composition.
The cooked hydraulic field is unconverged and is not calibrated against observed Hance behavior across playable releases.
No named guide, geospatial reviewer, geologist or ecologist, environment artist, water-VFX artist, or target-hardware reviewer has accepted the result.
